_comment: Sessions used by every day3 script. To add a session collected later, add one entry: loader 'clean_tree' reads any folder built by clean-data/2026-11-24/scripts/build_clean.py (manifest.csv, floor*/stops|walks/<folder>/<phone>/<Sensor>.csv, wifi/observations.csv); 'names' maps its node names onto graph-v2 place names (see names_24nov.csv for the columns). Then rerun: sh phase2/new/day3/run_all.sh

sessions.note: stops only logged magnetometer + barometer (iPhone17,4), no accelerometer, so no tilt features
4 phones; iphone = iPhone19,2 (not the same handset as 24s2)
